title: Lunch with Stubblebine about Buchanan's clearance

tellings.quote: >> Bert and I were out at at lunch and he said, "What is your clearance?"

plain: Some time in the 1980s, over lunch, a man named Albert Stubblebine, whom he calls Bert, asked Army Sergeant Lyn Buchanan, "What is your clearance?", meaning his level of access to secret material. Buchanan tells Michels this himself as something he took part in. It matters to him as the moment his security standing came under the eye of someone who could open doors for him.
